create_xcit_backbone: create an XCiT backbone model for semantic segmentation with configurable depth, embed_dim, and patch_size
build_conv_patch_embedding: build a ConvPatchEmbed module that converts images to patch embeddings using multi-layer convolutions
create_xca_attention: create a Cross-Covariance Attention (XCA) layer that updates channels via softmax-normalized cross-covariance matrix
create_class_attention: create a Class Attention layer that computes attention between the CLS token and all other tokens
create_local_patch_interaction: create a Local Patch Interaction module that enables explicit communication between tokens in 3x3 windows
